class Token:
    def __init__(self):
        self._positions = []

    def addPosition(self, aPosition):
        self._positions.append(aPosition)
        return True

    def removePosition(self, aPosition):
        if aPosition not in self._positions:
            return False
        self._positions.remove(aPosition)
        return True

    def getPosition(self, index):
        return self._positions[index]

    def getPositions(self):
        return list(self._positions)

    def numberOfPositions(self):
        return len(self._positions)

    def hasPositions(self):
        return len(self._positions) > 0

    def indexOfPosition(self, aPosition):
        return self._positions.index(aPosition) if aPosition in self._positions else -1

    def delete(self):
        pass

    def __str__(self):
        return (super().__str__() + "["
                + "]")
